user_query: Our family is planning to move to Stuttgart and we want to ensure that our electricity comes from renewable energy generation facilities in the same region. Can you give me a list of postal code areas where consumers can receive electricity from renewable energy generation facilities located in the postal code area 70173? Additionally, what is the resulting mix of electricity generation after applying regional renewable energy generation in that area?

TaskList.description: 查询邮政编码70173区域内的可接收可再生能源电力的用户区域列表。
分析并计算该邮政编码区域在应用区域内的可再生能源发电比例后，得出最终的电力组成比例。
